cards.title: Passing the Camel Humps
instructions: Descend to 1,000' MSL · slow to 200 KIAS
Proceed north up the shoreline toward the Shrimp Ponds, paralleling the Intracoastal Waterway
Stay south of the Flour Bluff Water Tower
cards.source: Binder, p. 49; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 53, 55.

cards.title: Contact Waldron Tower

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Waldron Tower, <callsign>, Camel Humps for touch and gos.

exchange.speaker: Tower
exchange.text: <callsign>, Waldron Tower, report the initial RWY {to.runway}.

cards.detail: Tower provides airfield wind, altimeter and runway information at check-in.
cards.source: Binder, p. 49; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 53.

cards.title: Fly to the initial, RWY {to.runway}
instructions: Do NOT overfly the Power Plant
cards.source: Binder, pp. 49–50; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 56–62.

cards.title: Initial and numbers

exchange.speaker: Tower
exchange.text: <callsign>, Waldron Tower, report the numbers RWY {to.runway}.

cards.detail: Pattern is {to.runway.patternSide}-hand. If two-way contact is not established by the Shrimp Ponds, or the pattern is full, turn right, fly south along the center of the ICW at 1,000' MSL and contact Corpus Approach · UHF CH 8.
cards.source: Binder, pp. 49–50; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 56, 62.
